reviews.t: Cheap Knockoff, Very Disappointed
reviews.x: Beware the other reviews - looks like a Chinese company with a fake knockoff planting pseudo-bubbly reviews. Here's an honest review - the thing broke on day one.  The rubber grips that hold the brushes barely fit any of my brushes (I have 30+ brushes from a dozen different companies) - the only ones that came close to being utilized were the 15mm for face brushes and the 7mm for eyeshadows. ***So JUST 2 grips fit a huge selection of brushes*** The 15mm was snug, but after squeezing a few of my

reviews.t: It worked great until it technically became unusable
reviews.x: I was so excited when I purchased this item. Today it was delivered and after cleaning 5 brushes, the main device basically broke. The piece where it connects to spin slides out causing it to not spin, meaning you have to hold it sideways, or upright in order for it to even work. I’ve attached pictures. It worked great until it technically became unusable.

reviews.t: Fun and efficient!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:710f56f772ae6847643f6bc48a6623a6]] Cleaning brushes can be so tedious, but this adorable little contraption makes it fun and is amazing! I recently covered and entire arm sleeve for a photoshoot and the brush I used was CAKED in concealer. This little brush spinner got it clean no problem! It doesn't dry the brush completely but definitely cuts down drying time by about 90%. You can just spin them dry, reshape a little then lay flat for a few minutes to let them dry totally. Much bette

reviews.t: It does not work, after I put all the ...
reviews.x: It does not work, after I put all the components together i lowered the brush into the bowl  with the brush shampoo/water mix I turned it on it stoped as soon as it hit the cleaning solution  not enough power to twirl the large brush very frustrating..

reviews.t: Great for medium to large brushes
reviews.x: This product fits easily onto your vanity or bathroom countertop. It includes a small plastic basin for washing 8 silicone sleeves, instructions, and a mechanical spinner. You will also need 2 AAA batteries, which are not included. I found this device to work extremely well for most brushes. It doesn't however work well with very small brushes. For example a liner brush. And it's certainly not the tool for oval brushes. Sleeves being to large to fit really small handles. And as for the oval brus

reviews.t: Fast drying! But using more brush shampoo than normal
reviews.x: After seeing this ALL OVER instagram, I had to try it. I was satisfied with how it cleaned my brushes (normally I use a textured mat). But I didn't care for how much brush shampoo I felt like I was using. Normally I use a tiny drop on my brush for the mat method, but I felt like I was using significantly more with this method.  Nothing beats how fast brushes dry with this product! Its important for brushes to dry properly so that bacteria doesn't build and the glue on the bristles doesn't break

reviews.t: It's OK
reviews.x: I found I could dispense with all the bother of setting up the brush to clean using the battery device and just swish the brush in the cleaning solution and dry it on a paper towel.  Cleaning solution is expensive and after one swish the fluid was filthy and had to be dumped and replaced, otherwise I was just swishing the brush in dirty cleaning solution. Maybe my brush was really full of makeup and more frequent cleaning will save on solution-remains to be seen.  Sorry this isn't such a resound

reviews.t: Does the job
reviews.x: Updated. First brush cleaner I got did not work. Customer service was very Nice and replaced new one to me. The cleaner does the job, the plastic container is a bit thin and looks like it won't last long but does the job for the price. Would recommend if you want something simple and affordable to do the job.  Box says it comes with batteries but it doesn't.

reviews.t: had my friend bring here brushes to try it out cleaned all but two that had to be soaked in water cause it was so dirty,
reviews.x: Cleans and dry's your brushes, had my friend bring here brushes to try it out cleaned all but two that had to be soaked in water cause it was so dirty, but for all my brushes it cleaned them well. The materials it's made out of a little cheap but easily something that can be looked over especially if you don't like cleaning your brushes by hand.

reviews.t: I would still recommend this product to anyone who likes to save time
reviews.x: This is such a time saver!! It cuts down in the time u would spend washing your brushes manually. I usually run each brush thru two or three times before they were cleaned to my liking. Otherwise I’d given five stars. I would still recommend this product to anyone who likes to save time

reviews.t: Lemon
reviews.x: This item would have 5 stars if it works but unfortunately it’s a lemon. The spinning action works and different size brushes fit on the connecting pieces but that’s about it. I used as instructed and it just got my brush wet, it doesn’t actually clean brushes.

reviews.t: ... money and buy Ecotools brush shampoo - it is amazing and easy to use
reviews.x: Save yourself some money and buy Ecotools brush shampoo - it is amazing and easy to use.  There is no need for this contraption.  Bought it and sent it back - felt cheap and was annoying to use.

reviews.t: Don't Buy This
reviews.x: This item was great....once.  the next time that I tried it, the handle kept detaching from the brush holder.  I thought maybe the batteries needed changed but that wasn't the problem either.

reviews.t: Dries the brushes nicely.
reviews.x: This doesn’t work worth squat for cleaning, unless you like to use half a bottle of cleaner on just a few brushes, but it works awesome to dry the brushes.

reviews.t: Makes your makeup brushes like new
reviews.x: I don’t relish cleaning my makeup brushes, but this nifty gadget makes it easy. I lined up my dozen or so brushes by handle size, used a few drops of Dawn dish soap in the bowl, spun them around, 2x if really dirty, replaced the soapy water as needed. Then rinsed. Repeat with the next sized handle.  It’s easy to swap out the tool that holds the handles. Wipe out the bowl. Lay the brushes on a clean towel to dry.  They were clean and fresh in no time at all. Tip: If you have a small bathroom sink

reviews.t: Don't hesitate get it!
reviews.x: Ok so I'm a cynic and was TOTALLY skeptical of this product. But I put it on my Christmas wish list and hoped for the best as washing my makeup brushes is my most hated task! I thought I'd give it a try. So Santa gave me one and I still wasn't sure so it sat there unboxed for a few weeks. Yesterday I thought ok I'll give it whirl with very low expectations! 30 mins later I'm cleaning every brush I could find, even raiding my travel set! This thing is amazing!!! ALL of my brushes look brand new a

reviews.t: This Makeup brush cleaner is perfect and work great for washing makeup brush
reviews.x: This works very well and dries the brushes amazing fast. I find I have to wash liquid foundation brushes through a little first, particularly thick ones. It's very necessary to clean you brush once two weeks, otherwise you might get problems on your face which I really don't want. This brush cleaner is perfect and work great for washing makeup brush. As usual, I wash my makeup brush once a week. It takes me more than 1 hour to wash and half of day to dry. After use this cleaner, just need few mi

reviews.t: LOVEE!! Any makeup user’s perfect gift!
reviews.x: What is this sorcery!??? THIS THING WORKS! I just cleaned my Sephora (and MAC) brush with this and it was so easy and worked so well!!  The quality of the plastic bowl, rubber brush heads and the gentle machine thing are all great! I simply followed the instructions, used method brand soap I got from Target to clean my brush, and it got rid of all of my gunk and yes, it was also DRY IN SECONDS!  DO NOT SPIN FOR MORE THAN 10 SECONDS AT A TIME THOUGH- I would even suggest just 8 seconds, because I

reviews.t: Works with some exceptions
reviews.x: This works as avertised. It’s quite hard to push the brush inside the silicone tube holder but once you find the right size, it works. Make sure that the fit is very snug though, or else it will spin unevenly from side to side and ruin your brush. The bowl is sturdy, however, the bowl’s edge is quite sharp. The instruction says to take off the rubber collar and wash both the bowl and collar separately. I find the sharp bowl opening to be quite dangerous. Also note that you can’t wash double-ende

reviews.t: I used it once so far. It worked well ...
reviews.x: I used it once so far. It worked well. It took two AA batteries. A little bit hard to pull the rubber wrap off. Updates (6/12/2018): The device had been broken. The part that held the metal needle, which was connected to the brush holder was broken. It first broken partially. And then total shredded. From the sound that it made after it was broken when you shake the handle, it was made from plastic. I have only been used the device several times so far. Downgrade the ratings.

reviews.t: I really love this brush cleaner
reviews.x: I really love this brush cleaner.  It cleans my brushes fast and I can't believe it - they look brand new.  I don't clean my brushes as often as I should and this cleaned them better than I even expected.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was that it is a little difficult to get the rim back on securely after cleaning the bowl.  It takes quite a few times to get it to fit.  Otherwise, great product.

reviews.t: Just "okay" for smaller brushes
reviews.x: Disappointed in this... it works just okay on brushes used with powder only and didn't work at all for brushes used with foundation, concealer, etc. I used it, but to really get the brushes clean I had to follow up with my usual method of cleaner in my hand. Smaller brushes were easier than the larger brushes but none of them actually dried by spinning. Will most likely return.

reviews.t: Finally something that helps clean AND dry my brushes!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:51a32bf2e67e4a244f1b630cb2a54735]] It works! I use hot water and dish soap because it breaks down grease and I changed the water about 4 times so I wouldn’t be washing in dirty water. It spins so well! See my video for proof. My suggestion is to use one size smaller brush holder than you think you need for optimal spinning!

reviews.t: Piece of crap
reviews.x: Used it once, didn’t clean my brush all the way (after 3 times emptying dirty water/solution and refilling with fresh), but I was satisfied enough. Went to clean the next brush, and the silver part that connects to the spinner on the wand won’t stay in, and therefore just falls out once you start to spin. Super disappointed.

reviews.t: Better than expected. I love it!
reviews.x: I was hesitant to buy this. This is one of the cheapest makeup brush cleaners. I went to fakespot to confirm if the reviews were fake and it do not have a good grade. Still, I decided to give it a go. To my pleasure it works wonderfully. Very precise and strong. Clean and dries the brushes very well. Highly recommended.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the device broke or stopped working quickly, sometimes on the first use or within days.
Many reviewers find it cleans brushes well and saves time compared to manual washing.
Some reviewers note the build materials feel cheap or flimsy.
A few reviewers mention it uses more brush shampoo/cleaning solution than expected.
Some reviewers say it works better for drying brushes than for cleaning them.
